events.event_name: Bobbi Brown The Prime Times Newsstand
events.address: Chelsea Triangle / Meatpacking Plaza, 9th Ave between W 14th and W 15th St, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-day Bobbi Brown newsstand activation celebrating the new Vitamin Enriched Face Base+ with product sampling, refreshments, scratch-off giveaways and a photo moment.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary Vitamin Enriched Face Base+ samples, refreshments and croissants, plus scratch-off giveaways while supplies last; the first 100 guests in line receive a deluxe-size sample.
events.caveats: The Eventbrite listing is organized by BOBBI BROWN Cosmetics and provides the direct registration page. Samples, refreshments and prizes are while supplies last. Photo/video content will be captured during the event for Bobbi Brown social and digital channels. Registration should not be described as guaranteed admission beyond normal venue/capacity conditions.
events.practical_notes: Thursday, September 17, 12 PM–6 PM at Chelsea Triangle in the Meatpacking District. First 100 guests in line receive a deluxe-size sample.

occurrences.details: Free RSVP through the Bobbi Brown Cosmetics Eventbrite listing; samples, refreshments and giveaways while supplies last.
